headline: Saudis want to sell the Gdańsk Refinery? Minister: they have not reported it
summary: Poland's state assets minister Wojciech Balczun said Saudi Aramco had not reported a wish to sell its stake in the Gdańsk refinery. He said there was much information noise around a potential sale.
why: Saudi Aramco is the state oil company of Saudi Arabia, and its stake in the Gdańsk refinery is a link to Polish fuel supply. Investors watch such ownership changes for effects on refining assets and regional fuel markets.
original_headline: Saudyjczycy chcą sprzedać Rafinerię Gdańską? Minister: nie zgłosili
